scope: Datacenter AI capacity explorer. Hardware presets provide reference dense-compute and maximum power values; facility power, representative PUE, capacity reserve, rack electrical/cooling envelopes, average accelerator power and non-accelerator IT overhead remain explicit user assumptions.
freshness_policy: Review accelerator presets and rack reference sources on upstream NVIDIA specification changes and at least every 90 days. Review PUE semantics when The Green Grid guidance changes materially.

presets.note_es: 989 TFLOP/s es el pico BF16 denso de referencia usado por NVIDIA para MFU; 700 W es el TDP máximo configurable, no consumo medio medido.
presets.note_en: 989 TFLOP/s is NVIDIA's dense BF16 reference peak used for MFU; 700 W is configurable maximum TDP, not measured average draw.

presets.note_es: NVIDIA publica 1.979 TFLOP/s BF16 con sparsity para H200 SXM; el preset usa la mitad como pico denso. El TDP máximo configurable publicado es 700 W.
presets.note_en: NVIDIA publishes 1,979 BF16 TFLOP/s with sparsity for H200 SXM; this preset uses half as the dense peak. Published configurable maximum TDP is 700 W.

presets.note_es: HGX B200 publica 36 PFLOP/s FP16/BF16 con sparsity para 8 GPU; el preset deriva 2,25 PFLOP/s densos por GPU. La guía DGX B200 documenta un límite máximo por GPU de hasta 1.000 W.
presets.note_en: HGX B200 publishes 36 PFLOP/s FP16/BF16 with sparsity for 8 GPUs; this preset derives 2.25 dense PFLOP/s per GPU. The DGX B200 guide documents a maximum per-GPU limit up to 1,000 W.

nvidia-h100.title: H100 Tensor Core GPU product specifications
nvidia-h100.notes: H100 SXM maximum configurable TDP is up to 700 W. The dense BF16 reference peak is represented as 989 TFLOP/s, consistent with NVIDIA MFU guidance.

nvidia-h200.title: H200 Tensor Core GPU product specifications
nvidia-h200.notes: H200 SXM publishes 1,979 BF16 TFLOP/s with sparsity and up to 700 W configurable maximum TDP; dense BF16 is represented as half the sparsity-assisted figure.

nvidia-b200.title: HGX B200 specifications and DGX B200 power guidance
nvidia-b200.notes: HGX B200 publishes 36 PFLOP/s FP16/BF16 with sparsity across 8 GPUs. DGX B200 documentation reports maximum per-GPU power up to 1,000 W under the full-power PSU configuration.

nvidia-b200-rack.title: Data Center Best Practices with DGX B200
nvidia-b200-rack.notes: Primary reference showing that rack electrical and cooling envelopes are first-class deployment constraints. NVIDIA documents example DGX B200 rack profiles around 28.6 kW for two systems and 57.2 kW for four systems, with site-specific airflow requirements. These figures are context only; the explorer keeps rack limits editable.

green-grid-pue.title: Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE)
green-grid-pue.notes: PUE is total data-center energy divided by IT equipment energy. Applying a representative PUE to a power envelope is an engineering approximation; actual PUE varies with operating point, climate and time.
